verdict.rationale: Llama ships as downloadable open weights with documented local and edge runtimes (desktop on Windows, macOS and Linux; mobile; edge devices). Running it yourself means inference data stays on infrastructure you choose, which gives residency control by self-hosting. Meta documents no region or residency controls or data-location guarantees, and region choice through cloud partners is a host-platform feature that earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region-selection documentation, any statement on where data is stored or processed, independent corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
